name: Mix #2
description:
Knowing how we're all moving toward the digital realm, it only made sense for me to give this a try, since I have not yet noticed any other organist even dare to enter the world of NFTs.

Behold, thanks to how programmable NFTs work, I've prepared different variants according to the crescendo (loudness) level of the virtual pipe organ I was using to produce this Organ Cover, ranging from the originally produced track, to pp (pianissimo) through ff (fortissimo) to full organ (a.k.a. tutti).

To explain the story behind why I chose to go with this particular piece of classical music, the name should explain itself. Since NFTs are pretty revolutionary in of themselves, it only made sense for me to choose this piece to be my first one to convert into an NFT version for Async, and to introduce organ music to the NFT realm in this manner.
